title: The arrival camera stays on Isao's face through the rise and the angry-to-happy change; the breach opens fourteen cells out
context: Owner: the camera must stay on Isao as he comes out and show the angry face and its change to happy; the breach should be further away so investigating it later needs a tank trip.
outcome: The landing sequence gains a hold after Isao is out (isao 9 s, isaoHold 3.5 s, phase 'hold'). The lab replaces the last rail keys with a follow shot in front of Isao's screen that blends in from the rail over 1.5 s and never drops below the door rim plus three metres, so it looks down into the well while he climbs. His screen stays angry until 93% of the rise, a beat past the rim, then glee for the drift and the hold. The fodder cell is fourteen lane cells outward instead of six. Acceptance frames: angry just out of the tube, happy during the hold.
evidence: node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world: PASS through the chain with the far breach
